reason: The preregistered Zenodo v1.1.0 annotation.zip endpoint and API-content fallback repeatedly returned HTTP 503 on GitHub-hosted runners and was also unavailable from the working container. All failures occurred before successful archive acquisition or scoring.

preFreezeMirrorProbe.purpose: Verify that the Hugging Face dataset-viewer endpoint exposes the declared v1.1.0 note schema and pinned revision.
preFreezeMirrorProbe.impact: The evaluation corpus is no longer perfectly label-unseen at the row level. However, the candidate artifact, hypothesis, scorer, tolerance and replication gate were all frozen before this probe and were not changed from its contents.

unchanged.replicationGate: unmatchedReferenceCount > assignmentDependentWrongPitchCount pooled AND separately for each player 00/01/03

amendedReferenceTransport.declaredLabelProvenance: canonical labels derived from the original JAMS
amendedReferenceTransport.materialization: Convert only mirror notes for players 00/01/03 into six minimal note_midi JAMS annotations, preserving onset, offset, continuous MIDI and string. The frozen scorer then rounds MIDI and performs exactly the preregistered onset-only matching.

scientificBoundary: This amendment changes transport/provenance only, not candidate, scorer, matcher, tolerance, gate, or hypothesis. No candidate-reference comparison or score existed before this amendment. Because two mirror rows were exposed during schema probing and the full mirror will now be consumed, players 00/01/03 must not be described as fresh after this point.
